blocks.title: Assessing credibility
blocks.text: Credibility parakhne ka matlab jaanchna hai ke maloomat mauzoo ke mahir ya ikhtiyar wale se aayi hai ya nahi.
Pakistan mein Eid ke chand ki khabar official Ruet-e-Hilal committee se aani chahiye, ghair tasdeeq shuda social media posts se nahi.

blocks.prompt: Tibbi mashware ke liye motabar maakhaz kaun hai?
blocks.explanation: Qualified doctor ya official sehat ka idara, gumnaam post nahi.

items: Credibility: kya maakhaz mahir ya ikhtiyar wala hai (chand ke liye Ruet-e-Hilal committee)?
